verdict.rationale: An email SaaS vendor could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. The probe found no llms.txt at superhuman.com/llms.txt (HTTP 404), and nothing in the pack describes machine-readable or agent-oriented documentation. The MCP server pages are evidence for a different story (connecting agents to the inbox), not docs an agent can be pointed at.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
